doc: docs/scenario-snapshots.md. Read by livecore.snapshot (python manage.py live_seed_snapshots). `defaults` apply to every incident; `incidents.<id>` overrides them key by key (objects merge, lists and scalars replace). Shares are fractions of households; counts are households, persons or vehicles. Coordinates are WGS84 [lon, lat].

occupants.note: ASSUMPTION (synthetic): persons per household, a stated shape close to the US national pattern (about 2.5 persons per household); not sourced in the repo and not specific to the area. Apportioned per zone by largest remainder, then shuffled with the incident seed.

vehicles.note: ASSUMPTION (synthetic): share of households with 0/1/2/3/4 vehicles. With match_zone_vehicles the per-household counts are then nudged (never changing who is carless) so each zone's sum equals the drill package's zone vehicles (homes x 1.6, also synthetic).

evacuating_vehicles.note: A household takes at most this many of its vehicles: evacuating = min(vehicles, cap). Matches the Camp demand table's vehicles_taken_cap = 2 and docs/people-data.md (Wong et al. 2020: 1.52-1.65 vehicles used per household when capped at 2).

needs_transport.note: A household with no vehicle needs transport. It stays in the snapshot with its occupants (population is conserved); it adds no evacuating vehicle. A household with unknown vehicles is not flagged.

positions.note: Household points are synthetic. Studio packages: the dispatch area's synthetic home points (every ~40 m along residential streets) when the cached area that built the package is still in MongoDB; otherwise, and for Camp, a road node inside the zone picked with the incident seed and moved up to jitter_m. Never real addresses.

engines.note: ASSUMPTION (synthetic): no staffing or apparatus data. Engine count per station = min + (sha1(incident|station) mod (max - min + 1)); kinds cycle through `kinds` (a local station's first engine is a Type 1 structure engine, the rest Type 3). Each engine's status at T+0 comes from sha1(incident|engine) against status_shares. Guarantees: at least `zero_available_stations` stations start with every engine committed (the station with the lowest sha1(incident|station|zero)), at least `multi_engine_stations` stations hold two or more engines, and at least `min_available_engines` engines start available.

occupants.note: ESTIMATED: each zone's occupants sum to its ACS 2014-2018 total population in the drill extract (replay bundle demand.zones.population_in_extract; includes group quarters). The per-household split uses the default distribution, then is adjusted to hit the zone total.

vehicles.note: ESTIMATED: per zone, carless households = ACS households_no_vehicle_in_extract (B25044); one-vehicle households n1 = 2(H - carless) - evacuating_vehicles, so min(vehicles, 2) sums exactly to the bundle's evacuating_vehicles; the rest hold 2 plus a share of the zone's ACS vehicles_available_total (scaled to the extract). Zones without vehicles_available_total use the pooled Camp ratio of extra vehicles per 2+ vehicle household.
